sonic_energy.description: Perceptual measure of musical intensity, dynamic volume, distortion, and sound pressure level.
sonic_energy.derivation_source: Root-Mean-Square (RMS) Energy & Spectral Centroid Brightness via Librosa / Spotify Energy

codes.label: Explosive
codes.definition: High-octane, heavy distortion, loud production, and maximum dynamic force (e.g. Hardcore, Grindcore, Metalcore).
codes.threshold: Librosa RMS > 0.12 or Spotify Energy > 0.82

codes.label: Energetic
codes.definition: Upbeat, energetic rhythm, punchy instrumentation, and lively production (e.g. Punk Rock, Fast Ska, Upbeat Rock).
codes.threshold: Librosa RMS 0.055 - 0.12 or Spotify Energy 0.60 - 0.82

codes.label: Moderate
codes.definition: Mid-tempo, balanced volume, steady acoustic/electric arrangement (e.g. Indie Rock, Mid-tempo Alternative).
codes.threshold: Librosa RMS 0.025 - 0.055 or Spotify Energy 0.38 - 0.60

codes.label: Subdued
codes.definition: Gentle, quiet production, intimate acoustic instruments, and subdued dynamics (e.g. Folk Ballads, Acoustic Solos, Ambient).
codes.threshold: Librosa RMS < 0.025 or Spotify Energy < 0.38

emotional_mood.description: Harmonic and emotional positivity conveyed by the musical arrangement and chord structures.
emotional_mood.derivation_source: Harmonic Chromagram & Tonnetz Major/Minor Key Ratios via Librosa / Spotify Valence

codes.label: Somber
codes.definition: Low positivity: minor-key, mournful, sad, elegiac, or desolate harmonic mood (e.g. Captivity Elegies, Slaughterhouse Laments).
codes.threshold: Librosa Major/Minor Ratio < 0.85 or Spotify Valence < 0.30

codes.label: Tense
codes.definition: Mid-low positivity: serious, urgent, tense, or confrontational harmonic tone.
codes.threshold: Librosa Major/Minor Ratio 0.85 - 1.05 or Spotify Valence 0.30 - 0.50

codes.label: Neutral
codes.definition: Moderate positivity: neutral, storytelling, or reflective harmonic background.
codes.threshold: Librosa Major/Minor Ratio 1.05 - 1.30 or Spotify Valence 0.50 - 0.68

codes.label: Uplifting
codes.definition: High positivity: major-key, cheerful, bright, encouraging, or triumphant feel (e.g. Celebration of Vegan Life).
codes.threshold: Librosa Major/Minor Ratio > 1.30 or Spotify Valence > 0.68

rhythmic_style.description: Rhythmic regularity, danceability, beat strength, and tempo momentum.
rhythmic_style.derivation_source: Onset Strength Envelope Variance, Beat Tracking, and Genre Metadata

codes.label: Aggressive
codes.definition: Rapid blast beats, relentless double-kick barrage, thrash beats, and heavy breakdowns (e.g. Death Metal, Grindcore, Hardcore Punk).
codes.threshold: Metal/Hardcore genre with Tempo > 140 or Librosa Onset Variance > 2.2

codes.label: Driving
codes.definition: Driving rock/punk beat, punchy 4/4 forward momentum, and steady rhythmic pulse.
codes.threshold: Rock/Punk genre or Spotify Danceability 0.40 - 0.68 with Energy > 0.55

codes.label: Groove
codes.definition: Syncopated beat, danceable rhythm, swing, reggae skank, and hip-hop bounce (e.g. Reggae, Ska, Hip-Hop, Funk, Pop).
codes.threshold: Spotify Danceability > 0.68 or Reggae/Ska/Hip-Hop/Funk genres

codes.label: Atmospheric
codes.definition: Loose beat structure, unmetered ambient passages, drone, spoken monologues, or non-rhythmic soundscapes.
codes.threshold: Spotify Danceability < 0.40 and Energy < 0.40, or Librosa Onset Variance < 1.2

acoustic_type.description: Primary instrumentation setup and acoustic vs electric/electronic sound spectrum.
acoustic_type.derivation_source: Spectral Flatness & Harmonic-Percussive Source Separation via Librosa / Spotify Acousticness

codes.label: Acoustic
codes.definition: Unamplified acoustic instruments, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, and organic folk production.
codes.threshold: Spotify Acousticness > 0.70 or Librosa Flatness < 0.003

codes.label: Hybrid
codes.definition: Blend of acoustic and electric/electronic instruments (e.g. acoustic guitar with electric drums/bass).
codes.threshold: Spotify Acousticness 0.30 - 0.70 or Librosa Flatness 0.003 - 0.012

codes.label: Electric
codes.definition: Electric guitars, bass, synthesizers, distorted amplifiers, and heavy studio production.
codes.threshold: Spotify Acousticness < 0.30 or Librosa Flatness > 0.012

vocal_delivery.description: Style of vocal presentation, ratio of spoken vs sung, and vocal technique.
vocal_delivery.derivation_source: Genre Metadata, Vocal Audio Analysis (ZCR / Speechiness), and Lyric Presentation

codes.label: Harsh / Screamed
codes.definition: Screaming, death growls, hardcore shouting, and guttural barking (e.g. Earth Crisis, Cattle Decapitation, Architects).
codes.threshold: Metal, Death Metal, Grindcore, Hardcore Punk genres with High Energy

codes.label: Melodic / Clean
codes.definition: Standard melodic singing, clean vocal lines, and harmonies (e.g. Folk, Pop, Melodic Punk, Indie).
codes.threshold: Folk, Pop, Blues, Indie genres or low speechiness with melodic vocal lines

codes.label: Mixed Delivery
codes.definition: Dynamic combination of clean singing and harsh screaming (e.g. Metalcore, Post-Hardcore) or singing with rap verses.
codes.threshold: Metalcore, Post-Hardcore, Alternative Rock with dynamic vocal shifts

codes.label: Rap / Flow
codes.definition: Rhythmic hip-hop cadence, rhyming flow, and rap delivery (e.g. Vegan Hip-Hop, Grime).
codes.threshold: Hip-Hop / Rap genres with high speechiness / rhythmic delivery

codes.label: Spoken Word
codes.definition: Spoken word poetry, activist monologues, speeches, and dramatic readings.
codes.threshold: Speechiness > 0.60 or spoken-word poetry metadata without rap cadence

codes.label: Documentary Sample
codes.definition: Audio samples from slaughterhouses, documentaries, speeches, or undercover footage embedded into the song.
codes.threshold: Tracks with prominent speech/documentary audio samples

codes.label: Instrumental
codes.definition: Purely musical arrangement without vocal performance.
codes.threshold: Instrumentalness > 0.70 or absence of vocal tracks

tempo_bpm.description: Exact musical speed and pace measured in Beats Per Minute.
tempo_bpm.derivation_source: Onset Autocorrelation Beat Tracking via Librosa / Spotify Tempo
